description: v10 competitor benchmark, lane N (new): nanopore-like channel = VNX-DNA's software simulator with the D13-F1 model (fitted to public ONT R9.4 reads, adequacy UNVALIDATED), negative-binomial coverage mean 10, applied identically to every codec's strands. VNX-DNA with the default decoder and with the opt-in decoder preset F. HEDGES chunk: seeds 1-3 and a 1800 s step limit, because one HEDGES decode of these reads did not finish in 600 s during the smoke test.
